_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Nderehe Player {player_id}, ojapo {num_rounds} ñembo Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Nde réra ${pool} oñondiveva ko’ápe jasy ko Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Eñõguare: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Mba’eichapa ojeikuaa → Nderehe oiko $(pool - X), hapykuére oiko $X
  - Mba’eichapa oñemboty → Mbohapy oiko $0
  - Ejemplo: [Offer: $3]  or  'Ndaguete oiko fair. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Oñembo’e ñemonguare mbohapy [Accept] or [Reject]
  - Ejemplo: 'Ko jevy oiko reason. [Accept]'
            'Too unfair. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Jasy {round_number} oñepyrũ! ---
Player {proposer_id} ha’e proposer, Player {responder_id} ha’e responder.
round.accepted: Player {responder_id} ojeikuaa! Jasy {round_number} oiko: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. New totals: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} oñemboty ñemonguare! Jasy {round_number} oiko: Mbohapy oiko +$0. Totals oiko: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.bad_integer: Oferta monto ha'eva'erã peteĩ número entero válido.
